name: Carysil Limited
summary: Carysil Limited and its subsidiaries make and sell kitchen and bath products internationally. These include quartz and stainless steel sinks, bath accessories, tiles, faucets, food waste disposers, chimneys, cook-tops, dishwashers and ovens, plus commercial kitchen solutions, marketed as Carysil and Sternhagen. The company dates from 1987 and has its headquarters in Bhavnagar.
